name: Russia–Ukraine
value: 6 killed, 45 injured in day to 16 Nov
summary: Russian strikes killed 6 and injured 45 in Ukraine in a day to 16 Nov; 158 drones launched, outages in six regions
state: Russian attacks killed six people and injured 45 across Ukraine over the day to 16 Nov, according to local authorities; Russia launched 158 long-range drones overnight, 131 of which were downed, and strikes on energy sites caused outages in six regions (Kyiv Independent; UNN). Kyiv had more than 20 air raid alerts in 24 hours. Talks have not produced a ceasefire, and sustained mass strikes on energy infrastructure keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to Ukraine. Expect continued pressure on European energy markets and aid needs.
rubric_hit: Mass drone strikes on energy infrastructure (158 drones, 16 Nov) = Alert
